h1: Nigeria Temporary Work Permit (TWP) from the UK
intro: The Nigeria Temporary Work Permit (TWP) is for short, specialist assignments in Nigeria, such as installing, maintaining or repairing equipment, or providing technical support. It is arranged with the company that needs your expertise.
eligibility: You are going to Nigeria for a short specialist or technical assignment
The Nigerian company has requested a Temporary Work Permit approval for you
You are not taking up long-term employment in Nigeria

sections.heading: How the Nigeria Temporary Work Permit works
sections.text: The company in Nigeria that needs your skills requests a Temporary Work Permit approval from the Nigeria Immigration Service. Once it is approved, you apply for the visa from the UK with the approval and your supporting documents.

sections.heading: Who the Temporary Work Permit is for
sections.text: The TWP suits engineers, technicians and specialists going to Nigeria for a defined, short assignment, such as installing, servicing or repairing equipment, or giving technical training. It doesn't allow you to take up a permanent job; for that, see the [Nigeria STR work visa](/nigeria-str-work-visa-uk/).

sections.heading: Documents for a Nigeria Temporary Work Permit
sections.text: Alongside the approval arranged by the Nigerian company, you'll usually need your passport, photos, a letter from your UK employer describing the assignment, your return flight booking and a yellow fever vaccination certificate. The letter should explain what work you'll do, where, and for how long, and that you'll remain employed and paid by your UK employer.

sections.heading: Nigeria Temporary Work Permit help from Manchester
sections.text: We help UK businesses and their engineers with Nigeria Temporary Work Permit applications, including urgent assignments. Requirements can change, so we confirm the current process before you apply.

faqs.q: How long does a Nigeria Temporary Work Permit last?
faqs.a: It is designed for short assignments. The period allowed is set in the approval, so we check it against your assignment dates.

faqs.q: Who arranges the Temporary Work Permit approval?
faqs.a: The company in Nigeria that needs your services requests the approval from the Nigeria Immigration Service.

faqs.q: Can I use a business eVisa instead of a Temporary Work Permit?
faqs.a: No. A business eVisa covers meetings and similar visits only. Hands-on technical work, such as installing or repairing equipment, needs a Temporary Work Permit.
